correctness.rationale: Surplus arcs necessarily form balanced two-edge graph, exhausting two constant loops and the unique alternating 2-cycle. Fixed-singleton-start BEST formulas correctly divide by arc multiplicity factorials. Loop factors cancel; alternating addition gives rank-one Laplacian perturbation and geometric finite sum, with P^(k-1)=Pi. Direct exhaustive k=2,3,4 counts and independently computed integer matrix-tree ratios k=2..7 match.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial excess over perfect de Bruijn coverage is a natural all-order object in cyclic k-mer reconstruction. The result proves a complete feasible-multiplicity classification and exact sizes of every reconstruction fiber, revealing an alternating 2-cycle with explicit parity-sensitive determinant response; it is not a single finite slice or a small numerical improvement.
